title: Alabare
content:
Lied auf Youtube anhören

Alabare (4x), Alabare A Mi Senor 2x

1. John Saw The Number, Of All Those Redeemed,
And All Were Singing Praises To The Lord
Thousands Were Praying, Ten Thousands Rejoicing
And All Were Singing Praises To The Lord.

Alabare (4x), Alabare A Mi Senor 2x

2. There Is no God as great as you, Lord
There’s None, there is none (2x)
There is no God Who Does the Mighty Wonders
That The Lord Our God Has Done! (2x)
Neither With An Army, Nor With Their Weapons,
But By The Holy Spirit’s Power (2x).
And Even Mountains Shall Be Moved (3x)
By The Holy Spirit’s Power.

Alabare, Alabare (2x), Alabare A Mi Senor
